title: Sparkly ice cream cone
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

    <linearGradient id='scoop2' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#FFF2B0'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#FFC94D'/>

  </defs>
